other_failure_modes.name: Test Feature Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Aggregations or transformations are computed on the combined train and test sets, leaking information about the test set's feature distributions into the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Feature Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Imputation statistics and frequency encodings are computed on the entire training set before cross-validation splits are created, leaking validation set information into the training folds.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated solution with custom PyTorch architectures, domain-specific feature engineering, and properly isolated out-of-fold target encoding. However, it inadvertently introduces feature leakage by computing group aggregations on the combined train and test datasets. Additionally, basic imputation and frequency encoding are computed on the full training set prior to cross-validation splits, causing minor internal leakage, and it relies solely on RMSE for evaluation.
